items.prompt: If a function locally assigns quantity=0, what happens to a caller integer variable passed as quantity?

options.text: The caller variable is automatically rebound to zero
options.why: A local name assignment does not rebind the caller name.

options.text: The caller integer object is mutated in place
options.why: Integers are immutable; this is not an in-place mutation.

options.text: The call fails because parameters cannot be rebound
options.why: Local parameters can be assigned new values.

options.text: The local name changes; the caller name stays as it was
options.why: Rebinding and mutating a shared mutable object are different.

items.explanation: Parameter names are local bindings. Assigning a new integer to a local parameter does not assign the caller variable.
